name: openkey
description: Integrate the OpenKey LLM gateway into your project and run your coding agent through it: one key, OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Gemini-compatible.

interface.shortDescription: Wire the OpenKey LLM gateway into your code
interface.longDescription: OpenKey is one LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Gemini-compatible endpoints. These skills teach the agent to point your project's SDK calls at OpenKey, pick valid provider/model ids from the live catalog, and run your coding agent through OpenKey, without ever handling your API key.
defaultPrompt: Switch this project's OpenAI calls to OpenKey
Which OpenKey model id should I use?
